takeaways: Higher Oak's prolonged content silence (now spanning multiple consecutive weeks) may signal internal restructuring, talent changes, or strategic repositioning — SMT should explore whether their UK/EU Qualtrics clients are seeking alternative partners and position accordingly in the Qualtrics Platinum Partner ecosystem.

Acceleration Strategy's sustained HIGH activity and aggressive Qualtrics AI content leadership in North America creates both a competitive threat and a potential co-opetition opportunity — SMT should monitor whether their Canada/US banking sector penetration is deepening and consider differentiation through proprietary AI frameworks or deeper vertical specialization in banking/retail.
